source_issues.description: Actual spectrum, irradiance or illuminance distribution, optical window/geometry, angle and calibration are missing. Radiometric and photometric rows cannot supply a universal conversion or guaranteed installed photocurrent.

Amplifier topology and bias, feedback impedance, total input capacitance, leakage, noise spectrum, bandwidth, settling target, ADC range/resolution and temperature are missing. Conditioned typical diode data do not establish TIA stability, signal-to-noise ratio or ADC accuracy.

Exact BPW34 bulk non-automotive scope only. Electrical revision 2011 and legal notice 2026 are different. No full CAD footprint, current compliance certificate, calibrated sensor model or system safety qualification is supplied. Unstated maximums, optical pulse amplitude and edge thresholds remain unknown.
